recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-17664 unless a future work-group decision changes the Questionnaire initial value/repeats rule.
issue_request: FHIR-17664 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire change request from STU3 requesting enforcement that an item cannot have multiple initial values unless the item can repeat; the final resolution was to add an invariant.
initial_application: The issue key does not appear directly in current git history, but commit b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e added invariant 13 to the pre-R4 Questionnaire spreadsheet on 2018-08-11 with the requested human text and FHIRPath expression. Later source refactors carried the rule into source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition still has que-13 on Questionnaire.item and references it from both Questionnaire.item.repeats and Questionnaire.item.initial. FHIR-41174 later treated que-13 as existing context while adding a parallel answerOption.initialSelected/repeats invariant. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already enforces the requested invariant and no source edit is needed.
